research_question: Can a graph built only from strictly prior cross-stock behavior transmit 08:58:59-known shocks or disclosures into same-session open-to-close rankings that survive an independent production-readiness gate?

authority.purpose: retrospective zero-base graph and propagation family falsification
authority.maximum_decision_from_this_run: retain one frozen candidate for a new prospective forward shadow

prior_research.title: 経済因果チェーンを用いたリードラグ効果の実証分析
prior_research.protocol_use: Motivates directed shock propagation, but the paper's text-extracted economic causal chain is unavailable here; price-derived edges are not treated as causal substitutes.

prior_research.title: 部分空間正則化付き主成分分析を用いた日米業種リードラグ投資戦略
prior_research.protocol_use: Motivates low-dimensional propagation and lead-lag structure; US ETF and sector data are unavailable, so no Japanese/US proxy is constructed.

prior_research.title: ニュースセンチメントのGranger因果関係に基づく銘柄間ネットワークを通した日本株式市場の情報伝播構造の分析
prior_research.protocol_use: Motivates directed information networks and supplies an important falsification prior: its major centrality measures had no significant future-return predictive power. Centrality alone is therefore not a candidate.

prior_research.title: 株式市場に埋め込まれたグループ相関構造―日米比較
prior_research.protocol_use: Motivates signed correlation networks and a fixed four-community archetype, without claiming that the historical four-group finding must persist.

external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.required_data: firm-to-firm economic causal or supply-chain edges
external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.forbidden_proxy: Do not relabel price correlation or lead-lag edges as economic causal-chain edges.

external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.required_data: timestamped US sector ETF returns and Japanese sector membership
external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.forbidden_proxy: Do not substitute prior_market features or endogenous communities for US sector observations.

external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.required_data: point-in-time per-stock news and social-media sentiment time series
external_data_limit_and_fail_closed_hypo.forbidden_proxy: Do not reinterpret TDnet category flags as news/Twitter sentiment.

separation_from_prior_work.relationship_to_z17: Z17 fit a Ridge to a same-training-date peer-relative target. This family instead freezes a strictly prior graph and propagates already-known lagged or overnight source messages; no score-date peer outcome exists in any feature or target.
separation_from_prior_work.relationship_to_v10_price_architectures: C00 and L4 are comparators only. Graph candidates contain no fitted price-feature coefficients and no local alpha search.

point_in_time_contract.fold_rule: For score month m, graph node selection, every edge, community, conditional-reaction table, comparator fit, and normalization statistic uses dates strictly before the first scored session of m.
score_features: oc_last, representing the prior exchange session open-to-close reaction
tdnet_clean_any only where tdnet_source_complete is true and its non-null source timestamp is at or before the cutoff
prohibited_score_information: target-session open, high, low, close, volume, open-to-close return, or label
point_in_time_contract.panel_source_date_check: candidate_price_source_max_date must be strictly earlier than score date whenever populated.
point_in_time_contract.tdnet_missing_rule: For G06, any score session that is not marketwide tdnet_source_complete abstains in full. Missing source is never encoded as no event.

sample_and_folds.scoring_rows: price_eligible rows on every score session

graph_node_scope.selection: Among codes present in the fold's training or score rows, rank by latest strictly prior no_trade_rate_20 ascending, then count of finite observed open-to-close returns in the graph window descending, then code ascending; retain the first 1536 qualified codes.
graph_node_scope.qualification: At least 60 finite price_training_eligible open-to-close returns in the trailing 120 panel sessions before the score month.
graph_node_scope.out_of_graph_policy: No graph score and therefore cash; no centroid, sector, or global-edge fallback.

shared_graph_contract.missing_vector_entries: Subtract the code's observed-window mean, set missing centered entries to zero, and L2-normalize the resulting vector. This attenuates incomplete overlap and is not pairwise-complete correlation.
shared_graph_contract.edge_tie_break: larger edge strength, then source code ascending
shared_graph_contract.message_normalization: For each score session, transform finite source oc_last or overnight_last values among graph nodes to average percentile ranks in [-1,1].
shared_graph_contract.edge_normalization: Set the diagonal to zero and normalize each target row by the sum of absolute retained incoming edge weights. A row without valid incoming edges is unavailable.
shared_graph_contract.community_algorithm: KMeans(n_clusters=4, random_state=20260723, n_init=10) on the first four eigenvectors of the symmetrized normalized positive-OC graph.

comparators.definition: v10 price architecture control: daily-percentile Ridge(alpha=1) on the fixed G0 15-feature bundle.
C00 plus flat_oc_rate_20, Ridge(alpha=1), evaluated through the same portfolio engine.
Known immutable v10 result reference only; not refit and not used in familywise paired inference.

registered_hypotheses.graph: For each target, the eight largest positive trailing-window OC cosine correlations.
registered_hypotheses.score: Row-normalized positive edge weights times current source oc_last percentile message.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available graph-node scores; missing slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: A prior-session shock continues into positively comoving neighbors after the open.

registered_hypotheses.graph: For each target, the eight largest absolute trailing-window OC cosine correlations, preserving their signs.
registered_hypotheses.score: Row-normalized signed edge weights times current source oc_last percentile message.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available graph-node scores; missing slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Both comovement and anticorrelation groups transmit economically useful signed messages.

registered_hypotheses.graph: For each target, the eight largest absolute corr(source OC at t-1, target OC at t), with direction source to target.
registered_hypotheses.score: Row-normalized directed signed weights times current source oc_last percentile message.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available graph-node scores; missing slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lagging stocks continue to incorporate prior-session moves of statistically leading stocks.

registered_hypotheses.graph: For each target, the eight largest positive trailing-window overnight-return cosine correlations.
registered_hypotheses.score: Row-normalized positive weights times current source overnight_last percentile message.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available graph-node scores; missing slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: A shared overnight information channel identifies stocks whose post-open reaction remains incomplete.

registered_hypotheses.graph: On each history date, a jump is abs(OC return) at or above that date's 90th percentile among graph nodes. Edge strength is the cosine similarity of signed jump vectors; retain eight largest positive edges.
registered_hypotheses.score: Graph pressure from source nodes whose abs current oc_last percentile message is in the outer 10 percent, preserving source sign.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available nonzero-pressure scores; zero or missing pressure abstains to cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Large prior-session moves propagate mainly through historical co-jump neighborhoods.

registered_hypotheses.graph: Use G03 directed topology. For each target-source edge, estimate the strictly prior mean target same-session OC return on marketwide TDnet-complete dates where the source had a preopen tdnet_clean_any event; require three event dates.
registered_hypotheses.score: Mean of qualified edge reaction estimates for currently event-active source neighbors.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Only targets with at least one active qualified source edge are eligible. Entire source-incomplete dates and all other slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: A source firm's preopen disclosure produces a repeatable same-day reaction in historically lagging neighbors.

registered_hypotheses.graph: Use the frozen G03 directed graph to reconstruct each target's one-session-lagged message over all strictly prior dates.
registered_hypotheses.score: For the current message sign, the target code's strictly prior mean OC return on dates with the same nonzero message sign; require 20 observations for each estimated sign.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Unavailable sign/code combinations abstain to cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Targets differ in how they react to the same network pressure, and a sign-conditioned empirical response captures that heterogeneity without a regression target.

registered_hypotheses.graph: Four fold-specific spectral communities from the strictly prior positive-OC graph.
registered_hypotheses.score: For the sign of the current community-average oc_last percentile message, use each target's strictly prior mean OC response on dates when its frozen community had the same lagged message sign; require 20 observations.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Unavailable community-sign/code combinations abstain to cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Endogenous market communities exhibit distinct lagged reaction archetypes even without external sector labels.

registered_hypotheses.graph: Square the row-normalized G01 adjacency, set the diagonal to zero, and row-normalize once more.
registered_hypotheses.score: Two-hop propagated current source oc_last percentile message.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Rank available graph-node scores; missing slots are cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Information reaches a target through an intermediary when direct pairwise dependence is weak.

registered_hypotheses.graph: Use separately frozen G03 directed and G04 overnight graphs.
registered_hypotheses.score: Average the two daily cross-sectional percentile scores only when both are nonzero and have the same sign.
registered_hypotheses.trade_policy: Any sign disagreement, zero, or missing component abstains to cash.
registered_hypotheses.hypothesis: Agreement between lagged-price and overnight propagation is a structural confidence signal; disagreement should remain cash.

outcome_and_portfolio.target: same-session open-to-close gross return in percentage points
outcome_and_portfolio.slot_weighting: equal fixed sleeves; unavailable or unobserved slots remain cash and pay no cost; no replacement after selection
outcome_and_portfolio.primary_metric: scheduled-session arithmetic mean after 40 bp round-trip cost

point_metrics: top1 and top2 mean, median, win rate at gross and 20/40/60 bp
filled slots, cash slots, filled sessions, unique codes, top-10 selection share
stability: net20 after removing the best 20 scheduled sessions
net20 after replacing the top 10 positive-contribution codes by cash

multiplicity.primary_comparator: the higher observed paired top1 net40 mean of C00 and C01
multiplicity.bootstrap: 10000 deterministic circular moving-block resamples within month, block length 10 sessions, seed 20260723
multiplicity.adjustment: single-step familywise max-centered-mean reality check and 90% simultaneous lower bound

integrity_and_reproduction: Every frozen input hash exactly matches.
Every graph edge, node selection, community, conditional table, and model training row is strictly before its fold score month.
candidate_price_source_max_date is strictly earlier than date wherever populated.
G06 never treats TDnet source-missing as no-event and every nonzero event timestamp is at or before 08:58:59.
Mutating every score-month oc_return_pct and label leaves all scores, eligibility decisions, and top1/top2 selection keys exactly unchanged.
An independent loop recomputes every saved-pick P&L and reported robustness metric.
A complete second run produces byte-identical picks and identical folds, graph diagnostics, and metrics.

independent_gate.selection: Among candidates passing every retrospective requirement, select the largest top1 net40 mean; otherwise retain no winner.
retrospective_requirements: top1 net40 uplift versus both C00 and C01 > 0
top1 90% familywise simultaneous lower bound versus the stronger comparator > 0
top1 net40 mean > 0 in all three temporal slices
top1 net40 mean > 0 in at least 9 of 13 months
top1 fills at least 80 percent of scheduled score sessions
all PIT, source, mutation, P&L, and deterministic reproduction audits pass
production_requirements: one immutable candidate passes every retrospective requirement
at least 120 newly observed strict-PIT prospective sessions after registration pass the same economic and robustness requirements
prospective top1 net40 has a one-sided 95% moving-block lower confidence bound > 0
any required external relationship source has timestamped observation provenance and is not replaced by a price proxy
explicit human production approval is recorded
